explication: Rembg removes image backgrounds through a Python API and several CLI modes: single-image, folder/batch, HTTP server, and RGB24 stream processing. The shared processing layer turns supported inputs into images, obtains a mask from a selected model session, optionally refines the mask or edges, and returns a cutout or mask. Model sessions cover local ONNX models and the optional withoutBG cloud backend. README documents these capabilities; sampled source confirms the core processing, session creation, server request handling, and selected model behaviors, but not every command’s implementation details.
